title: 3D loose guns: Laser Gun, Energy Shotgun, Svalinn and cell
scope: Art only: source-faithful 3D held/dropped Laser Gun, Energy Shotgun, Svalinn and PowerCellSmall, with actual charge/mode/cell states; no gameplay code or unrelated energy weapons.
target_runtime: Minecraft Java 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.224: existing ItemRenderer baked-item and loose block_model/NONE route, neoforge:obj + MTL #atlas + atlas PNG + complete item wrappers; not wearable interchange or sprite-only models.
dependencies: Use the frozen MODEL-BRIEF.md and MODEL-SAMPLES.md contracts and pinned SS14 entity/RSI references.
Independent of ballistic requests. LaserGun/EnergyShotgun have integral batteries; only Svalinn has the selected removable-cell slot.
Selective unshaded indicators or new state predicates must be documented as integration boundaries, not invented custom loaders/shaders.
brief: Create true volumetric 3D models for WeaponLaserGun (retro laser_retro design), WeaponEnergyShotgun, WeaponLaserSvalinn and PowerCellSmall. Follow exact pinned silhouettes/palettes, five-step charge indicators and only actual source-visible mode distinctions. Provide Svalinn cell-present/cell-absent appearance and its separate small cell. Do not invent removable batteries for the integral-battery guns or make whole models fullbright/translucent to mimic small source indicators. No flat sprites, sprite-on-box proxies, generic block guns or code-generated placeholders. Deliver complete supported native OBJ/MTL/#atlas PNG/item-wrapper groups, both-hand held transforms and documented NONE-context world placement. Include editable projects, grip/muzzle/support-hand/cell-port documentation, source comparison, six views, atlas, held/dropped/state review images and per-file provenance/license. Read the attached brief for canonical paths and material limitations. Delivery is not acceptance/import.
